subject.title: [Feature]: Thread replies when agent uses tools; top-level for conversational responses

question: Should Slack add a default-off tool-use-sensitive reply policy, and what precedence should it have relative to replyToMode, per-channel overrides, DMs/group DMs, existing threads, explicit top-level opt-outs, streaming previews, and status indicators?
rationale: Current source shows the feature is absent, but adding the proposed config and routing heuristic changes compatibility-sensitive Slack delivery behavior and needs product-owned precedence rules before implementation.

options.title: Approve precise Slack policy
options.body: Define the config shape and precedence, then implement the Slack-owned schema/routing/docs/tests path with default false so existing installs keep current behavior.

options.title: Use static reply controls only
options.body: Treat account and per-channel replyToMode as the supported solution for channel cleanliness and close this feature as not planned.

options.title: Defer to broader reply-policy design
options.body: Hold this issue until maintainers design a cross-channel reply-placement policy that can cover Slack without one-off config drift.

recommendation.title: Approve precise Slack policy
recommendation.body: Define the config shape and precedence, then implement the Slack-owned schema/routing/docs/tests path with default false so existing installs keep current behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged and reviewed the nearest Slack reply-mode implementation and is the clearest owner signal for the delivery-policy decision.
